concerns.text: T006b (Download OQMD/AFLOW) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T004 (Ingestion logic). T004 implements the retry/backoff logic required for T006b to function correctly. A task that consumes an artifact (retry logic) cannot run in parallel with the task that produces it. T006b must be sequential to T004.
T006c (Checksum verification) is marked [P] but depends on T006b (Download). The checksum file cannot be generated until the data file exists. T006c must be sequential to T006b, not parallel.

T008 (Imbalance Scores) is marked [P] but depends on T006b (Data Download) and T007 (Descriptors). T008 cannot run until both data and descriptors are available. T008 must be sequential to T006b and T007.

T012 (Contract Test) and T014 (Contract Test) are marked [X] (complete) but depend on T010b and T010c (Schema Generation), which are marked [ ] (unimplemented). A consumer task (Test) cannot be marked complete if its producer task (Schema Gen) is not yet defined or implemented.

T049, T050, T051, T052, T053 are marked [P] and placed in Phase 2, but the 'Dependencies' section explicitly states they must be implemented before T047 (Full Pipeline). However, T049 (Error Handling) and T050 (Verification) are logically dependent on the implementation of T004 and T006b. If T004/T006b are not yet complete, T049/T050 cannot be implemented. The [P] tag implies they can run in parallel with T004/T006b, which is impossible as they verify the code in those tasks.

T019 (Verify T012/T013 pass) is marked [X] but depends on T012 and T013. While T012/T013 are marked [X], the logical flow implies T019 is a verification step that should occur *after* T012/T013 execution. Marking it [X] alongside the tasks it verifies is acceptable if the phase is complete, but the dependency note 'requires T012/T013 completion prior to T016' suggests T019 is a gate. Ensure T019 is not marked complete until T012/T013 are actually run.
